status: deterministic protocol-correction addendum; not a post-hoc hyperparameter choice
source_experiment: fixed-final-epoch multi-seed architecture and RoPE screen

corrections.scenario_aggregation: unweighted macro mean of T1, T2 and T3
corrections.old_0.5_0.3_0.2_field: historical unofficial proxy only; ignored for current decisions

decision_rule.primary: mean equal-macro rollout RMSE across seeds below paired MLP
decision_rule.seed_consistency: beat paired MLP in at least 2 of 3 seeds
decision_rule.static_control: beat Static in at least two scenarios
decision_rule.long_history_signal: improve mean T2 or T3 RMSE over MLP by at least 5 percent

evidence_boundary: 12D invariant-feature proxy; not atomic Geo/Phys/Dyn/Stab and not an official score
